title: Pind Hospitality IPO Details
intro:
Pind Hospitality IPO is a book build issue of ₹17.82 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 18.00 lakh shares of ₹17.82 crore.

Pind Hospitality IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Sep 30, 2026. The allotment for the Pind Hospitality IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 1, 2026. Pind Hospitality IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 6, 2026.

Pind Hospitality IPO is set issue price band at ₹93 to ₹99 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,37,600 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,56,400.

Fedex Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Bhansali Value Creations Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Pind Hospitality IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Updated on Sep 23, 2026 Incorporated in June 15, 2021, Pind Hospitality Limited is engaged in the hospitality sector, specifically in hotels and restaurants. The company has completed over 5 lakh deliveries and is recognized as one of the long-standing restaurant partners in Pune by third-party food delivery apps. Services: Restaurants: The company, along with its partnership firm Pind Punjab, operates six restaurants in Pune, Maharashtra, with no permanent closures since 2016. Delivery: The company serves customers through third-party food delivery apps, its own mobile app, online bookings, and phone orders. It also offers mobile pre-ordering for pick-up within a 6 km radius. Outdoor Catering: The company also offers outdoor catering services for special events and workplace canteens, with revenue of 528.61 lakhs, ₹ 125.37 lakhs and ₹ 64.38 lakhs in the Fiscal 2026, Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2024 in recent periods. Advertising Strategy: The company targets middle and upper-middle-class consumers through advertising focused on fresh, affordable food. It uses various media, including internet, print, direct marketing, and social media, to increase brand awareness. The Company have taken four (4) restaurants on leave and license basis in Pune, Maharashtra (“PHL Restaurants”) and one (1) restaurants are taken on leave and license basis by Pind Punjab in Pune, Maharashtra The company sources raw materials from local and organized vendors to meet safety and quality standards, including perishable items like dairy, vegetables, and meat. Restaurants undergo routine audits for FSSAI compliance. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 135 staff, who formed a part of the central functions including finance, human resources and administration. Competitive Strengths: Experienced Promoters, management team and dedicated staff Attractive offerings at competitive prices based on constant menu innovation and customer focus. faqs.question: How to apply in Pind Hospitality IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Pind Hospitality IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Pind Hospitality IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Pind Hospitality IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Pind Hospitality IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Pind Hospitality IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Pind Hospitality IPO opens on Mon, Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Wed, Sep 30, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Pind Hospitality IPO?
faqs.answer: Pind Hospitality IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,37,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Pind Hospitality IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Pind Hospitality IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Pind Hospitality IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Pind Hospitality IPO will be done on Thursday, October 1, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Oct 5, 2026 . Check the Pind Hospitality IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Pind Hospitality IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Pind Hospitality IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Oct 6, 2026 .
